[[File:GTA_SA_Madd_Dogg's_Rhymes.jpg|thumb|Stealth Is All It Is]]

This is your introduction to stealth missions and there's really no need for a walkthrough. The basics of it all is to crouch and kill the guards with your knife. If one of them is alerted, it's okay, you just have to knife them all out of your way. Once you get the rhyme book, you could sneak out or shoot your way through.

== Rewards ==
* '''Respect''': +4
* '''Weapon''': Knife
